title: Escaped debug/help prompts unbalance saved terminal screens

impact.description: Reported manual/debug-command behavior. Actual native reachability, effect and consumer applicability still require independent validation.

notes: Borg-rs lead, not a newly proven C-game outcome. Preserve harmless/dead/manual-only qualifications.
next_at_import: Validate the cited C context and legal debug scenario with controls; deduplicate related mechanisms before any local fix proposal.

references.description: C function context only; fault/reachability not independently verified here

reported_sources.text:
`do_cmd_borg()`: an escaped command prompt calls `Term_load()` without a
  matching `Term_save()`, so it pops a screen saved by someone else (or
  nothing). `borg_cmd_help()` saves once and loads twice when the nested
  prompt is escaped, and `borg_cmd_target()` (`G`, `I`, `D`) starts with a
  `Term_load()` whether or not it was reached from the help.
